speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to begin my assessment, please tell me your age and how long you have noticed this lump. Additionally, have you experienced any pain, nipple discharge, or skin changes like dimpling in the area?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Carcinoma (rapidly growing mass in a 48-year-old woman raises high suspicion for malignancy). I will now request imaging to confirm the findings.

REQUEST IMAGES: Mammogram and Ultrasound of the left breast.

REQUEST TEST: Breast MRI with contrast.
